epic.summary: Let customers reschedule deliveries in the app
epic.description:
Customers phone support to move deliveries, which costs staff time.

## Goal
- Self-service rescheduling from the mobile app

## Out of scope
- Bulk reschedules for business accounts

stories.summary: Show a reschedule button on scheduled deliveries
stories.description:
As a customer I want to reschedule so that I avoid calling support.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scheduled delivery, when I open it, then I see a Reschedule button.

subtasks.summary: Expose reschedule eligibility in the API
Add the button and its states to the app

stories.summary: Pick a new delivery slot and confirm the change
stories.description:
Customers choose from available slots.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given I am eligible, when I pick a slot, then my delivery moves to it.

Notify the customer.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a completed reschedule, then a confirmation email is sent.
